metadata.description: Keyline keeps your coding agent's UI in your design system, and proves every change in a real browser before it ships.

plugins.name: keyline
plugins.description: One skill with eleven commands — init, sync, audit, smoke, type, color, layout, depth, motion, patterns, polish — that keeps your agent's UI in your design system through a DESIGN.md written in your project's own names, and proves each change in a real browser.
